answer: The question is not how to spot a clone but how to make one expensive. Elected track maintenance supervisor commission with track gangs certification answers it: a commission gangs issue after section audits, so the forge of a hundred clones is a hundred times the forge of one. Every clone is charged full price a second time, a tenth time, a hundredth time; the orchard is the reason the farm either stays tiny or collapses. The signal is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
